patthana9.12:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca ... no cittasahabhuṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana9.12:3.1: cittānuparivattiṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... no
patthana9.12:14.1: upādinnaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... noupādānagocchakaduka nakusalattikaṃ no upādānaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nokilesagocchakaduka nakusalattikaṃ no kilesaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na
